recognize_zh: 這是腹部冠狀切面的 MRI 影像（非敘述中寫的 CT），量測顯示肝臟長徑約 181.8 mm、脾臟約 129.5 mm，皆明顯增大；肝脾腫大支持肝硬化合併門脈高壓，是棘狀紅血球貧血（spur cell anemia）的臨床背景，但影像本身不能診斷溶血。
features: Coronal cross-sectional abdominal MR image (signal characteristics and bright subcutaneous fat indicate MRI rather than CT)
Hepatomegaly with measured craniocaudal liver span of 181.8 mm
Splenomegaly with measured splenic length of 129.5 mm
Liver appears relatively hypointense compared with spleen on this sequence; surface nodularity cannot be reliably assessed at this resolution
describe_en: This is a radiologic image, a coronal abdominal MR image, rather than a blood smear; the case description refers to CT, but the image characteristics are those of MRI. It demonstrates hepatomegaly (craniocaudal span 181.8 mm) and splenomegaly (splenic length 129.5 mm). Relative hypointensity of the liver is noted but should not be over-interpreted on a single sequence, and cirrhotic surface nodularity cannot be reliably assessed here. Hepatosplenomegaly in advanced liver disease provides the clinical context for spur cell anemia, in which altered lipid composition produces acanthocytes that are removed by the enlarged spleen; the diagnosis itself rests on the peripheral smear and hemolysis parameters.
